problems.explain: Each inch on the floor plan is 8 ft, so 17 inches is 17 × 8 = 136 ft. (Dividing would make the real thing smaller than its picture.) So 136 ft.

problems.explain: 1 : 24 means every length on the real car is 24 times the model’s, in the same unit. 17 × 24 = 408 in. There are 12 inches in a foot: 408 ÷ 12 = 34. (The scale has no units of its own, so the answer comes out in inches first.) So 34 ft.

problems.explain: 1 : 72 means every length on the real plane is 72 times the model’s, in the same unit. 3.5 × 72 = 252 in. There are 12 inches in a foot: 252 ÷ 12 = 21. (The scale has no units of its own, so the answer comes out in inches first.) So 21 ft.
